/*사이트구분*/ , (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'TX06' AND CODE = DECODE(CM.SYS_TYPE,'KW',(select legacy_department_code from tbl_department WHERE CUSTOMER_CODE=1418 and department_code = CM.KEP_DEPT),CM.KEP_DEPT)) KEP_DEPT /*팀구분*/ , DECODE(IR.IRS_NAME,NULL,CM.COM_NAME_LOC,IR.IRS_NAME) COM_NAME /*거래처*/ , DECODE(IR.IRS_NO,NULL,CM.IRS_NO,IR.IRS_NO) BUYER_IRS_NO /*사업자등록번호*/ , CM.CLOSE_CNT CLOSE_CNT /*마감횟수*/ , CM.BILL_TYPE BILL_TYPE /*발행주체*/ , nvl(CM.BILL_CODE,'99') BILL_CODE /*전자세금계산서_발행사이트*/ , (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM V_VOC_ICOMLUSR WHERE SYS_TYPE = 'KA' AND USER_ID = CM.KEP_USER1_ID) KEP_USER1_NAME /*담당자(정)*/ , (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM V_VOC_ICOMLUSR WHERE SYS_TYPE = 'KA' AND USER_ID = CM.KEP_USER2_ID) KEP_USER2_NAME /*담당자(부)*/ , (SELECT MAX(C.USER_NAME_LOC) FROM BILL_ACCOUNTING C WHERE C.PRIORITY='Y' AND C.COM_CODE=NVL(IR.COM_CODE,CM.COM_CODE) AND C.IRS_NO=NVL(IR.IRS_NO,CM.IRS_NO)) AS AC_USER_NAME , (SELECT MAX(C.PHONE_NUMBER) FROM BILL_ACCOUNTING C WHERE C.PRIORITY='Y' AND C.COM_CODE=NVL(IR.COM_CODE,CM.COM_CODE) AND C.IRS_NO=NVL(IR.IRS_NO,CM.IRS_NO)) AS AC_USER_PHONE , (SELECT MAX(C.FAX_NUMBER) FROM BILL_ACCOUNTING C WHERE C.PRIORITY='Y' AND C.COM_CODE=NVL(IR.COM_CODE,CM.COM_CODE) AND C.IRS_NO=NVL(IR.IRS_NO,CM.IRS_NO)) AS AC_USER_FAX , (SELECT MAX(C.EMAIL) FROM BILL_ACCOUNTING C WHERE C.PRIORITY='Y' AND C.COM_CODE=NVL(IR.COM_CODE,CM.COM_CODE) AND C.IRS_NO=NVL(IR.IRS_NO,CM.IRS_NO)) AS AC_USER_EMAIL , (SELECT MAX(C.ZIP_CODE) FROM BILL_ACCOUNTING C WHERE C.PRIORITY='Y' AND C.COM_CODE=NVL(IR.COM_CODE,CM.COM_CODE) AND C.IRS_NO=NVL(IR.IRS_NO,CM.IRS_NO)) AS AC_USER_ZIP , (SELECT MAX(C.ADDRESS_LOC) FROM BILL_ACCOUNTING C WHERE C.PRIORITY='Y' AND C.COM_CODE=NVL(IR.COM_CODE,CM.COM_CODE) AND C.IRS_NO=NVL(IR.IRS_NO,CM.IRS_NO)) AS AC_USER_ADD , (SELECT MAX(C.ACCOUNTING_CODE) FROM BILL_ACCOUNTING C WHERE C.PRIORITY='Y' AND C.COM_CODE=NVL(IR.COM_CODE,CM.COM_CODE) AND C.IRS_NO=NVL(IR.IRS_NO,CM.IRS_NO)) AS AC_CODE , CM.COM_CODE /*거래처코드*/ , CM.SYS_TYPE /*사이트구분*/ , TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(COM_NAME_LOC,'(유)',''),'(사)',''),'(주)',''),'㈜','')) AS COM_NAME_LOC_ORDER , CM.BUSINESS_COND FROM V_VOC_ICOMCMPY CM , KEPTIRSN IR /* 고객사 사업자정보 */ WHERE 1=1 AND CM.SYS_TYPE IN( 'KA' ,'KK')/* 조회조건 : 사이트(site) : KA 로 고정 */ AND CM.STATUS <> 'D' AND CM.COM_CODE = IR.COM_CODE(+)
AND (CM.COM_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' || #{st_com_name} || '%' OR IR.IRS_NAME LIKE '%' || #{st_com_name} || '%' ) /*조회조건 : 회원사(comName)*/
AND CM.KEP_DEPT = #{st_dept} /*조회조건 : 해당팀(dept)*/
AND CM.CLOSE_CNT = #{st_close_cnt} /*조회조건 : 마감횟수(closeCnt)*/
AND CM.BILL_TYPE = #{st_bill_type} /*조회조건 : 발행방법(billType)*/
AND (CM.KEP_USER1_ID = #{st_user} OR CM.KEP_USER2_ID= #{st_user}) /*조회조건 : 담당자(user)*/
AND (CM.IRS_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_irs_no} || '%' OR IR.IRS_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_irs_no} || '%' )
ORDER BY COM_NAME_LOC_ORDER
